description: Discover your match with Dear Body.
concept: Confident personal-style detail of one adult Filipina woman, strictly waist-and-hands only, wearing a tailored rich cherry-red cotton blazer over a warm cream top. Cropped neck/head entirely excluded. One hand holds AMBER OUD SILK upright in front of a textured golden-tan clutch at her waist, correct white label and very pale peach liquid; the other hand loosely knots a short burnt-orange silk scarf around the clutch handle. One clean geometric gold ring. Vivid matte burgundy-red wall and red fabric dominate with warm light, cream label luminous. This is fashion editorial photographed outdoors, tactile cloth and real warm skin, no mirror, no generic dressing-table scene. Top30% relatively calm dark-red wall for cream type. Bottle center x54%,y58%, real palm-sized, cap to base complete. Bottom simple red tailored fabric.
